brief.headline: Lock a 7–10% price cut on Dextrose by qualifying two backup suppliers and pushing payment to 45 days.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹60–61/KG on Dextrose, down from ₹66.48/KG today
priceAsk.basis: The open-market asking price band for Anhydrous Dextrose IP is ₹60–81/kg, with most deals at ₹66–73/kg. We're at the top of that typical range. India's export unit value sits at 42.95 ₹/kg. With three credible Indian makers ready to quote and two global majors as fallbacks, we can push toward the floor of the typical band.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move payment from 30 days after receipt to 45 days after receipt
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Stretching terms by 15 days frees up ₹61.76 L of cash for us to use elsewhere

brief.financialLeverage: Sayaji publishes no financials, so we can't see their profit, debt or cash picture. That means we build our case on what we do know: we spend ₹15.03 Cr a year with them on Dextrose, we already pay a market-fair price, and we have six other dextrose makers lined up (three Indian-listed firms that make the exact anhydrous form we need, plus Roquette and Ingredion). Without visibility into their books, the smartest move is a firm but not aggressive push—use the backup sources to justify a modest price cut and longer payment, then watch how they respond to gauge how much room they really have.

evidence.point: We spend ₹15.03 Cr a year with Sayaji
Our current Dextrose price is at the top of the typical market range
The open-market ask band runs as low as ₹60/kg
India's export unit value for Dextrose is much lower
Extending payment by 15 days releases over half a crore for our own use

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: Listed Indore maize wet-miller; makes Dextrose ANHYDROUS (IV-fluid grade) — exact form match; confirm IP monograph CoA before switching

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker; established dextrose/sorbitol supplier — a drop-in alternate to Gujarat Ambuja/Sayaji

alternates.name: Roquette India Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Indian arm of global starch major Roquette — pharma-grade dextrose/excipients; premium, very reliable (₹2898.05 Cr revenue)

risks: Sayaji's financials aren't public, so we don't know if they're healthy or stretched — be ready to soften the ask if they push back hard or hint at supply trouble.
We're already their customer at ₹66.48/KG with no competing source today; switching to Tirupati or Gulshan means audit, CoA checks and lead time — don't bluff a switch you can't execute in 60 days.
If Sayaji walks, we lose our sole Dextrose line until a backup clears quality — keep the tone firm but not hostile, and float a trial order with one alternate now to show we're serious.
Roquette and Ingredion are premium, reliable players but may price higher than ₹66.48/KG — use them as quality benchmarks, not low-cost threats.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the Dextrose supply, but at ₹66.48/KG we're at the top of the market and we've lined up three other Indian makers who can match the anhydrous IP spec — let's talk about moving closer to ₹60/KG and stretching payment to 45 days.
